recipe.title: Quick Costco Salmon Dinner
recipe.summary: A fast salmon dinner with chicken rice, green beans, and a lightly dressed side salad for approximately 40 grams of protein and 405 calories.
recipe.story: This is the kind of dinner I make when life is busy and I still want a balanced plate without starting from scratch. The salmon does most of the work, while a small portion of chicken rice, plenty of green beans, and a simple side salad make it feel like a complete meal. It is especially useful on sick days, travel days, or nights when cooking needs to stay easy.
instructions: Warm the salmon, chicken rice, and green beans until heated through.
Measure 5.5 ounces of cooked salmon onto a dinner plate.
Add 1/4 cup of prepared chicken rice and 1 cup of cooked green beans.
Place 2 cups of salad greens on the side.
Drizzle the salad with 1 teaspoon of vinaigrette and serve.
tips: Use a kitchen scale to measure the salmon after cooking for the most consistent serving.
Keep the rice portion to 1/4 cup so the meal stays close to the 40/400 target.
The homemade vinaigrette is made with olive oil, red-wine vinegar, salt, black pepper, and granulated garlic.
Nutrition is approximate and may vary with the exact salmon, rice preparation, and vinaigrette ratio used.
